title: Yellow Embroidered Cotton Tunic Top for Women with Black Floral Yoke
color_custom: Sunshine yellow with black floral embroidery
description:
Bold, bright and made to be noticed. This sunshine-yellow cotton tunic carries a striking black floral embroidery yoke – lotus blooms and climbing vines framed around a notched neckline. One piece, instant statement.

✦ The Details
• Notched round neckline with embroidered border
• Dense black thread embroidery on the V yoke
• 3/4 sleeves
• Hip length with short side slits
• Easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft and breathable. The thread embroidery is dense and dimensional, so the yoke stands out beautifully against the yellow.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual top size – size up for a relaxed, boxy look.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue flared jeans and clear heels; black trousers for a sharp office look; oxidised silver jhumkas for haldi or a festive lunch.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
